0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-2, 1st in the East) as they try to snap a six-game losing streak, while Philadelphia comes in on a one-game skid after a strong start. Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) are out for Chicago, and Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Joel Embiid (plantar fasciitis) is day-to-day with a game-time decision; the 76ers beat the Bulls 126-107 in Philadelphia in their only meeting this season, while Chicago won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
